shape.parent: the widget that receives the fragment (a screen: its Content)
shape.html: the fragment inline, instead of file

(html element).rule: Tag = the tag, class -> extended property; any tag of the platform's HTML Element (api --op html, platformTags), tables too; br: an empty Container

form.rule: class -> Style; children are its content

popup.rule: show -> ShowPopup; children are native popup content; events inside use Fade

radio-group.rule: bind -> Variable; radio-button value -> Value; onchange names an action

radio-button.rule: value -> Value; children are its caption

list-item.rule: native list item with authored children

text.rule: children are explicit literal text, including literal braces

(literal text).rule: no class of its own; a space next to an inline element stays

{{ expression }}.rule: OutSystems, copied as written (never JavaScript); a binding of a constant ({{ "Search" }}) is folded into the text around it

i.rule: icon = the icon name; weight where the icon has one (ODC: mandatory; the O11 icon has none, as its reading writes it)

input.rule: bind names an existing variable, placeholder -> Prompt, type text|password|number|time|date|datetime-local|tel|email|search; the bound data type decides the InputType

select.rule: bind -> Variable, options -> List, value -> Values, label -> Labels, empty -> EmptyValue; value and label read the element of options by its attributes (Item.Id for an aggregate over Item, Id for a list of records), never options.Current

button.rule: onclick (or href): an action or screen, Name(args) or :Input passes inputs; children are its content; empty with aria-label/title

label.rule: for -> TargetWidget (an input id of the fragment); with child elements: an HTML Element label with them

div[list].rule: Source = list; as is mandatory and names the row inside {{ }}

(html element)[list].rule: Source = list; Tag preserves the element; as names the row inside {{ }}

div[if].rule: children: True branch; a <div else> right after: False branch

Block.rule: name = an existing block, inputs by :Name, handlers by @Event="Action" or, as the reading writes them, @Event="Action(Input = expression)", children by <slot name>

ButtonGroup.rule: bind -> Variable; each <ButtonGroupItem value> an IButtonGroupItem, its text an Expression; also written <button-group> and <button-group-item>

switch.rule: bind names an existing Boolean variable

upload.rule: content or bind -> FileContent (a Binary Data variable), filename -> FileName; accept -> Accept; no enabled or disabled (no Upload has Enabled, in either lane)

style.rule: scoped under the root class; light-dark() expanded, @keyframes kept, @import to the top

attributes: enabled/disabled, required/mandatory, maxlength and empty use native properties; onchange names a native action; unsupported os-* is refused; any other attribute: an IExtendedProperty, {{ }} makes an expression
names: id: name, alias $id; else Tag1, Tag2; Block none
rejected: an <i> without weight where the icon has one (ODC)
a name that does not exist in the module
